sloka: यस्मादर्था विवर्धन्ते येष्वधर्मः पतिष्ठितः।क्लिश्यन्ते धर्मशीलाश्च तस्मादेतौ निरर्थकौ ।। ६.८३.२१ ।।
transliteration: yasmādarthā vivardhante yeṣvadharmaḥ patiṣṭhitaḥ।kliśyante dharmaśīlāśca tasmādetau nirarthakau ।। 6.83.21 ।।

translations.english: "Since those rooted in unrighteous develop and are wealthy, and those who follow dharma suffer both these are meaningless."
